name: HR recruiter hiring from a competitor
persona: Talent partner at Orvane Robotics, recruiting engineers and managers away from a direct competitor. Uses chatbots to write outreach messages, offer letters, interview debriefs and comp comparisons. Mentions candidate names, the company they are poached from, salaries and internal job levels.

labels.label: CANDIDATE_NAME
labels.description: Names of job candidates or employees we are discussing.
counterExamples: a hiring manager title like 'the VP Engineering'

labels.label: SOURCE_COMPANY
labels.description: The competitor we are recruiting candidates away from, when named in a hiring context.
counterExamples: a competitor mentioned in a public news article

labels.label: COMPENSATION
labels.description: Salaries, bonuses, equity amounts and internal job levels or grades tied to a person or offer.
counterExamples: average market salary from a public survey
